# DECISIONS

## ADR-M00-001 — Portable Go core

Status: ACCEPTED

Use Go for the portable DoctorCode core and expose language/compiler support through adapters.

Rationale: Single-binary distribution and cross-platform CI keep deterministic core use simple.

## ADR-M00-002 — GitHub Actions acceptance authority

Status: ACCEPTED

Use GitHub Actions Linux, Windows, and macOS runners as public runtime and acceptance authority.

Rationale: The public project must not depend on the Owner PC.

## ADR-M00-003 — Fail closed on unsupported sequence extraction

Status: ACCEPTED

Do not infer a Go call graph from the current generic Skill_Workflow sequence extractor.

Rationale: Current generic extraction covers Python AST and JS/TS HTTP structure, not Go symbol call graphs.
